ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer Bodge Jobs
ModMetaData.author: Zapdude
ModMetaData.description:
Bodge jobs for this mod list. Each job is independent and disables itself with a log warning if the Multiplayer build it targets is not the one it was written against.
Unbound weapon customization sync. Persona Weapons Unbound and Unique Weapons Unbound start the customize job through Pawn_JobTracker.TryTakeOrderedJob, which Multiplayer already syncs. The desync is the second half: the dialog commits the chosen spec by calling JobDriver_CustomizeWeapon.SetSpec on the already-running driver, and that call only happens on the client that pressed Confirm. Every other client then runs the job with a null spec and bails. This patch routes the commit through a registered sync method so all clients set the same spec.
